name: Recipe Box
description: The family recipe collection, unique per placement. Space editors store recipes with ingredients, steps, servings, tags, and notes, then read them from a clean cooking view set like a well-made recipe card. Search and tag filters keep a growing collection easy to browse. Everyone else, including anyone the frame is shared with publicly, sees a live read-only view of the collection. Recipes live in encrypted LocalTables scoped to the placement, and the owner can graduate the collection to a shared table so the Meal Planner and future kitchen frames work over the same recipes. Every change is pushed live to all viewers.
